column1: # The launcher copies this file to $HOME/ComfyUI/model-set.manifest; the fetch
# script verifies every sha256 before moving the file into place. Order is
# smallest-first so the bounded mechanism check sees a landed file quickly.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored by the fetch/check scripts.
# Sizes (GiB) are for the operator's disk budget, not parsed by the fetcher:
# Core total for all rows below is ~127.94 GiB.
# Existing model-set files are listed too (fetch_verified skips a present file).
# The DEFAULT CHECKPOINT is intentionally NOT here: COMFYUI_MODEL_URL /
# COMFYUI_MODEL_SHA256 remain its single source, fetched synchronously before
# the server starts. This file is the single source for the model SET.
